Recommendation: Well producing 100% water — likely water breakthrough or reservoir depletion: Causes: 1) Water coning/channeling from aquifer, 2) Casing/tubing leak allowing water influx, 3) Reservoir pressure depletion. Recommended actions: 1) Verify production test (separator test or sampling), 2) Check GOR trend (near zero indicates water dominance), 3) Review well completion to find water source, 4) Consider temporary shut-in or zonal isolation, 5) Evaluate re-perforation or water-shutoff treatment.
